1.title: How the Pentagon Is Getting Into the Venezuelan Oil Business Under Trump
1.summary: The Defense Department’s Office of Strategic Capital, founded by the Biden administration to give loans to bolster the U.S. defense industry, is helping lead President Trump’s oil deal.

2.title: Wendell Berry, Writer Who Extolled America’s Agrarian Past, Dies at 92
2.summary: A Kentucky farmer, he railed against agribusiness and championed small family farms and the environment, winning widespread acclaim.

3.title: Lindsay Clancy Murder Trial: Jury Struggling to Reach a Verdict
3.summary: Jurors sent a note after about 18 hours of deliberations saying they were deadlocked. The judge sent them back to keep deliberating.

4.title: Keir Starmer, Former UK Prime Minister, Says He Will Resign From Parliament
4.summary: Keir Starmer, who left Downing Street in July after pressure from his own party, said he would quit his parliamentary seat to focus on a role in international affairs and defense.

5.title: Israeli Operation in Gaza Kills 4, Palestinian Officials Say
5.summary: Israel’s defense minister said the operation resulted in the capture of a senior Hamas member. Hamas said Israel sent covert operatives into Gaza City.

6.title: Sexual assaults happening almost every day in Ceuta, prosecutors say
6.summary: Most migrants have returned to neighbouring Morocco, but as many as 5,000 remain in the Spanish exclave.
